title: Repository normalization: first REVIEW pass -- inventory, classification, ranked delta candidates (jnwb/ + omission/)

generated.summary: First REVIEW half of the XIII normalization algorithm. jnwb/ inventoried directly (26 files, 6,345 lines, no per-module READMEs, jrsa.py is a 1,552-line outlier). omission/ inventoried via a background Explore agent: scripts/ 259 files/54,027 lines, legacy/ 152 files/27,206 lines (zero live imports anywhere -- confirmed dead), context/ 1,098 files/31,785 lines (mostly context/figures/, already has 25 READMEs), jnwb_ext/ 21 files/13,571 lines (zero READMEs), artifacts/ 88 files/9,481 lines, tests/ 35 files/5,342 lines, docs/ 7 files (dated snapshots, likely superseded by context/PROJECT_STATE.md). Two confirmed broken authority links found and fixed this pass: root README.md pointed at a nonexistent repo-root .claude/skills/ with a stale 9-skill list; omission/README.md pointed at a nonexistent context/docs/CONTEXT.md as its authoritative source (3 instances, all fixed to point at context/PROJECT_STATE.md + context/EVIDENCE_ARCHITECTURE.md, matching CLAUDE.md's own 'where truth lives' table).

notes: FIXED this pass: README.md stale .claude/skills/ pointer; omission/README.md's 3 dangling context/docs/CONTEXT.md references (2 prose + 1 table row).

jnwb_ext/ candidates flagged by the omission/ inventory as plausibly generic and worth a PROMOTE_TO_JNWB evaluation (NOT yet evaluated against the IX promotion criteria -- general API, tests, docs, no omission constants, no hidden corpus assumptions): connectivity.py (2,022 lines, largest file in the repo, Granger/PSI/transfer-entropy math), spectral.py (648 lines, band power/coherence), viz.py (1,434 lines, plotting infra), decoding.py (337 lines, generic SVM wrapper), session.py (1,029 lines, flagged as 'likely overlaps/extends a generic jnwb session class' -- needs a direct diff against jnwb/'s own session-adjacent code before any conclusion).

legacy/ (152 files, 27,206 lines) confirmed via repo-wide grep to have zero live imports from anywhere outside itself -- strong ARCHIVE/DELETE candidate, but not yet actioned: deletion of 27k lines is exactly the kind of decision this pass should discuss before executing, not do unilaterally, even under the suspended freeze. Also contains a second CLAUDE.md (legacy/markdowns/CLAUDE.md) -- worth checking it isn't accidentally discoverable/confusable with the live one before any action.

notebooks/historical/reproducibility_master_pipeline is already effectively quarantined (referenced only by a guard test, test_no_retracted_census_in_live_code.py, not by live code) -- low-risk ARCHIVE candidate alongside legacy/.

omission/docs/ (7 files, dated snapshots: SESSION_HANDOFF_*, agent_harness_audit, handout_* specs) look superseded by context/PROJECT_STATE.md and context/handoff/ -- candidate to fold in or archive, not yet actioned.

context/docs/EVIDENCE_ARCHITECTURE_20260809.md is NOT a defect -- EVIDENCE_ARCHITECTURE.md's own text says it is 'preserved unedited in the pre-reset archive', i.e. this is the doctrine's own correctly-executed Conservation/quarantine pattern, not stale drift.

README coverage is better than initially assumed: 29 READMEs already exist under omission/ (mostly per-figure under context/figures/). The real gap is jnwb_ext/, scripts/, legacy/, notebooks/, tests/, docs/, artifacts/ having zero READMEs -- scripts/ (259 files, 54k lines) and jnwb_ext/ (21 files, 13.5k lines, the actual public-surface-adjacent code) are the highest-value gaps.

Several versioned script pairs (aggregate_lfp_lfp_coupling_corrected.py, extract_spike_lfp_coupling.py/_v2.py, compute_omission_identity_*_v1/_v3/_leakage_safe) need cross-checking against context/PROJECT_STATE.md for which version is canonical before any MERGE/ARCHIVE action -- not yet done. scripts/historical/confounded/ (9 files) is already correctly quarantined.

jrsa.py (1,552 lines, largest file in jnwb/) flagged as a giant-module candidate for the SPLIT-vs-KEEP evaluation (VII) -- not yet evaluated for internal coherence (may be one legitimate operation family, in which case KEEP is correct per VII's own 'one coherent 500-line module over six arbitrary 80-line modules' preference).

omission/__init__.py's 421-line flat re-export ('LEGACY API for backwards compatibility', __status__='Stable - Public API Frozen') is NOT yet classified as unnecessary -- it is explicitly versioned/declared as a stable public contract (2.0.0, frozen 2026-08-19), not accidental complexity. Needs a usage check (does any live code depend on the flat surface vs. jnwb_ext submodule imports) before any VIII absorption action.
issues: This is a partial, first-pass review of a very large tree (omission/ alone: ~1,750 files, ~140k lines across scripts+context+legacy+artifacts). Not exhaustive -- scripts/ and context/figures/ were inventoried at the directory/count level, not file-by-file.

No PROGRESS deltas beyond the two README fixes have been executed yet; several flagged items (legacy/ removal, jnwb_ext promotion candidates, script deduplication) require a human decision per the normalization algorithm's own rule before execution.
